questions.model_answer: If baseline HIV viral load is >100,000 copies/mL, avoid rilpivirine-based regimens (reduced virologic efficacy/higher failure rate at high baseline viral loads); also avoid two-drug regimens not validated at high viral load (e.g., dolutegravir/lamivudine when VL >500,000, and dolutegravir/rilpivirine switch regimens).
questions.beyond_mandell: DHHS/IAS-USA antiretroviral treatment guidelines; this is ART regimen-selection guidance not covered in the assigned HIV virology chapter of Mandell.

cohort_answer.text: Parvo B19, HIV, HHV6, EBV, CMV

questions.question: Congenital HIV and HBV to mother with no prenatal care.

parts.text: How to prevent HIV transmission, list two mechanisms?
What two things are given to prevent HBV transmission?

cohort_answer.text: HIV prevention mechanisms: ART during pregnancy; C-section if viral load is >1000 copies; Intrapartum AZT if >1000 (or consider if 50-999 copies, no need if <50 copies); No breastfeeding; Triple empiric HIV therapy for baby. HBV prevention: Treat mother 28wks onwards; HBIG and Hep B vaccine

parts.text: Name five viruses that can cause it

cohort_answer.text: HIV, HBV, Parvovirus B19, CMV, EBV, Flaviviruses (Dengue, Zika), Hepatitis A (can be associated with transient neutropenia in early stages), Measles, Rubella, HHV6
